name: Sons of the Architect
lore: The Primal Architect is renowned for his talent at civil engineering. With the might of his legion, he can raise walls, build infrastructure, and establish defenses to protect and provide for a whole city in a matter of days, maintaining unbroken vigilance even as the Rifts erode his work away.

rules.name: Wrath of the Architect
rules.lore: The Primal Architect leads his legion to where the fighting is thickest, there to ruin the enemies of mankind.
rules.text: Reroll Wound rolls of 1 for Attacks made against your army's Vow of Eternity target.

strategems.name: Raise the Bastion
strategems.target: Your +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit being Activated that is wholly within range of an objective marker
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, models in the target unit have the Benefit of Cover and +1 to their =arrows-to-circle= Objective Control trait.

strategems.name: Siege Calculus
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, each time a model in the target unit makes an attack against a +Monster+, +Vehicle+, or your Vow of Eternity target, re-roll Wound rolls of 1. Against your Vow of Eternity target, also improve that attack's =shield-minus= Armor Break by 1.

strategems.name: Unbroken Vigil
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move within 18" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit
strategems.effect: The target unit can shoot as if it was Activated, but it must target that enemy unit, and only if that enemy unit is an eligible target. Until the end of that shoot sequence, ranged weapons equipped by models in the target unit have +[Heavy]+.

spells.name: Chronal Scaffold
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Legion of the Architect+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, models in that unit have an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+ and the Benefit of Cover.

spells.name: Collapse the Span
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" that is within 3" of a Terrain feature. That unit suffers d3 Mortal Damage, and until the end of the Battle Round it does not receive the Benefit of Cover from Terrain.

spells.name: Bastion Pulse
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit within 18" of this +Psyker+. Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit has +1 to its =arrows-to-circle= Objective Control trait, and enemy units cannot use +Secure Objectives+ while within Engagement Range of it.

upgrades.name: Disciple of Strategy
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ and models in its attached unit (if any) have +1 to their =arrows-to-circle= Objective Control trait.

upgrades.name: Indomitable Warrior
upgrades.text: The first time a friendly +Juggernaut+ +Character+ unit is destroyed, roll d6. On a 2+, the unit remains on the Battlefield with 3 =Heart= Health remaining.

upgrades.name: Champions of the Battle
upgrades.text: Melee weapons equipped by your +Warlord+ (and by models in its attached unit, if any) have +1 to their =swords= Attacks trait.
